CLOUD COMPUTING — TOPIC SYNTHESIS AND PRACTICE
====

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
----
• Say what cloud computing — topic synthesis and practice means in plain words.
• Give one Kenyan example linked to Cloud Computing.
• Correct one common mistake about this page.

INTRODUCTION
----
A learner studying COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH meets cloud computing — topic synthesis and practice first by naming the idea, then by using one Kenyan example from a school compound in Machakos. In plain words: describe the service models in cloud computing,.

MAIN NOTES
----
• Cloud Computing — Topic Synthesis and Practice helps you understand Cloud Computing in COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH.

• Use accurate subject words — do not replace them with vague slogans.

• Respect safety, honesty, and other people when you practise Cloud Computing.
• If two ideas look similar, compare them: say what is the same and what is different.

WORKED EXAMPLE

First, state the idea clearly: Understand and practise: describe the service models in cloud computing,
Next, apply it to one object or action at a school compound in Machakos and name what changes or what stays the same.
Finally, write one accurate conclusion sentence a teacher could tick — using the correct subject words for COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH.

IN EVERYDAY LIFE

Ask: what did I observe, which word or formula fits, and how do I check I am right? Use the diagram or working on this page as your model. Safety and respect come first.

----

REVISION QUESTIONS
----
1. Define cloud computing — topic synthesis and practice in your own words and give one clear example.
2. Describe a situation at a school compound in Machakos that shows Cloud Computing, using ideas from this page.
3. A learner makes a mistake about cloud computing — topic synthesis and practice. State the wrong idea, correct it, and justify your correction.

ANSWERS
----

2. At a school compound in Machakos, observe carefully, name the correct idea from Cloud Computing, and explain with one subject fact from the main notes.
